graph.title: LEGO Brick Sketches 40386 Batman
notes: Piece ids use the element/design numbers from the inventory page (most are not in the supplied catalogue, so they are drafted as new types with generic stud/anti-stud ports).

Stud/anti-stud joins leave both ports null: one large plate carries many separate studs and the picture-only booklet does not let me assign specific stud positions, so naming a single port would wrongly make it single-use. Axle and clip joins keep named ports.

The booklet is pictorial; which plate carries which neighbouring piece (for example which of the three 4x8 black plates takes a given tan or black piece) is inferred from the step images and is approximate.
Left/right wedge allocation among 4180536/4180508 and 6141554/6141556 was inferred from the inventory counts (3+3 and 2+2).
Step 22 flips the model over; the back frame plates and bricks (b59-b66, b74-b76) are modelled as joined to the base plates and to each other, with contact edges for frame bricks resting on the base.

The Step 26 stand (two elbows joined by the red axle extender, two axles with end connectors) clips onto the two 1x2 bar-holder plates (b64, b65) with a revolute clip/bar joint (the 4183035 plate now has a bar port, replacing the earlier clip-to-clip pairing) so it can swing out as on page 49.
Pages 1-8 are cover, designer text and a 'how to' picture; pages 49-50 show the finished model standing; page 52 is feedback info.
